A cat of Việt Nam (mèo ta): a small short-haired cat, about 25 cm at the shoulder, gray with a white chest and white paws, a long thin tail up.
A domestic cat: about 23 to 25 cm at the shoulder, about 46 cm long without the tail, 3.5 to 4.5 kg. The template is a fox; the numbers of the shape are a guess from photos.
